design.motif: A crafted gateway instrument's work surface: restrained brushed-brass grain, matte enamel inset seams, a pair of offset vertical guide rebates and one open threshold indentation. Architectural and tactile, no literal door, terminal text, circuit reset route, status light or logo.

description.en: Restrained brushed-brass grain, matte enamel inset seams, a pair of offset vertical guide rebates and one open threshold indentation.
description.zh: 细黄铜拉丝、珐琅嵌缝与错位门框浅槽，承接网关工具的接入关系，保留开门的余地。

design.rationale: The existing object, character or historical mark remains unchanged. Only a supporting working surface is interpreted from the product's purpose; no replacement Logo is generated.

description.en: Run Hermes in Herdr with optional monitoring
description.zh: 在 Herdr 中运行 Hermes，按需打开监控面板

purpose.en: Run a dedicated Hermes Gateway inside Herdr with explicit lifecycle control, persistent pause intent and JSON diagnostics. A compact startup page opens an optional hqtui monitor for multiple Profiles, with live status, CPU and memory trends.
purpose.zh: 在 Herdr 内运行专用 Hermes Gateway，提供明确的生命周期控制、持久暂停意图与 JSON 诊断。启动时先显示简洁状态页，按需打开 hqtui 面板，查看多个 Profile 的实时状态、CPU 和内存趋势。

rights: Owner-commissioned Azure OpenAI generated decoration under applicable provider terms. No third-party reference image or font was submitted. Existing Logo, font and product rights are unchanged. Do not describe raster output as handmade SVG or assert exclusive trademark rights.

contrast.method: WCAG relative luminance on every native RGBA pixel composited over actual Hexly normal/hover surfaces, before the left-edge mask. Text remains fully opaque.

publication: Export-time record. Upload receipts and the site release establish subsequent publication.
